steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2024, Equity Mates noted GYG recorded one of the biggest boosts in word of mouth in June per YouGov, and a guest on Equity Mates said they personally loved the food, highlighting strong product appeal and brand buzz.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Rundle - Catapult, Dominos, Guzman y Gomez and more

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates contrasted franchise economics and said Domino’s franchisees struggled to make money, whereas GYG franchisees made good money, implying stronger unit economics for GYG.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Rundle - Catapult, Dominos, Guzman y Gomez and more

views.text: In June 2024, Equity Mates compared profitability using EBITDA and said GYG’s margins were 21.6% for drive-thru and 19.8% for strip stores, sitting around the middle versus peers like Chipotle and Wingstop in the mid-20s and Sweetgreen at 17%.

episode.title: Guzman y Gomez is going public: We speak to co-CEOs Steven Marks and Hilton Brett

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said the US side of the business was not going particularly well but saw enough runway in Australia to grow earnings, highlighting strong individual store metrics.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Rundle - Catapult, Dominos, Guzman y Gomez and more

views.text: In June 2024, Equity Mates outlined GYG’s growth platform with 185 Australian stores at March 2024, split between 62 corporate and 123 franchise, plus a master franchise in South Australia and corporate stores in the US.

episode.title: Guzman y Gomez is going public: We speak to co-CEOs Steven Marks and Hilton Brett

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates recapped a pitch where GYG had about 200 locations globally and aimed for 1000 in Australia, signalling a large runway for domestic expansion.

episode.title: We review the 16 stocks pitched at the Sohn Hearts & Minds conference

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In September 2024, Equity Mates noted GYG traded around $35 shortly after listing and was above prospectus forecast, pointing to strong early market enthusiasm.

episode.title: Buffett bags the trillion, Zip is so back & kids that day trade

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said it was hard to get conviction at the IPO because the valuation was fairly stretched.
